label.match_evidence: ORLP is dollar for dollar match, meaning it covers up to 50% of all project costs. Applicants are responsible for providing non-federal funds for at least 50% of project costs.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The program focuses on outdoor recreation and does not align with any specific health or human services objectives in the NC DHHS Strategic Plan.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The program focuses on outdoor recreation and does not align with any specific veteran services objectives in the NC DMVA Strategic Plan.
